description: This PHP class 'Currency' is part of a validation framework within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling validation rules for currency codes, ensuring they are valid three-character strings associated with a recognized CurrencyType entity.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input is a valid currency code, specifically a three-character string that matches a CurrencyType entity.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input is a string of length 3 and corresponds to a recognized CurrencyType entity.
